origin: A review agent stages a move; the session disposes it. Where a staged choice asks what happens outside the one event the record ties a rule to, the record has in fact already answered — a decided event whose consequence follows with no alternative — so the row is rewritten `settled` with that derivation before anything renders, and it lands from the settled batch with the rest. A choice that clears the bar in the same walk still stops and still lands its pick in the discussion that should own it, so the dispose has to discriminate rather than blanket-settle.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments specification to run its review; construction finished last sitting, so offered the resume choice they continue. They know the discussion cold and treat what it determines as decided, not theirs to re-litigate — the quoted total was settled with one release only, the customer's own edit to the cart, and they hold to that reading whenever it comes up. The first thing the review puts to them is a two-row screen of calls made on their behalf — the missing 30-day refund window and what the quoted total does when the payment step re-renders — each with what it rests on named beside it, offering to document the screen, to hand every remaining call over automatically, to pull one out and talk about it, or to expand one. They hand the rest over automatically: both rest on things the record has already decided, and they do not want to be stopped for those. The failed-webhook retry ceiling is different and they treat it differently: nothing decided how long the checkout keeps waiting, and both ways cost a customer something real. Asked, they reject the recommendation — three attempts is too few for a bank having a bad morning, and they would rather hold a customer's order for a day than lose it — and pick the 24-hour reconciliation option instead. The follow-up review cycle runs without asking them and comes back clean, and the session moves to completion on its own; at sign-off they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely and never reopen decided questions.
